producer_report.summary: The producer's cargo wrapper now links the job's CARGO_TARGET_DIR to the held slot's warm target directory (build-slots/<n>/target, the checks' directory) with BuildLink::create, called with the job directory (the parent of shim.dir). It then runs cargo and drops the link when cargo exits, which removes only the link. Unslotted subcommands are untouched. A missing target directory or a path outside the job (D46) gives a warning on stderr and cargo runs unlinked. I added 4 tests with a fake cargo and a CHANGELOG entry. The root cause was that the producer built in its own cold directory, so concurrent jobs each held a full target tree.

criteria_check.criterion: A test in crates/athena-cli/src/slot_exec.rs: a slotted `build` run with a fake cargo observes the job's CARGO_TARGET_DIR path as a symlink resolving to <slots_dir>/<n>/target during the command, and the path is gone after run returns. Check: cargo test -p athena-cli slot_exec.
criteria_check.evidence: Test a_slotted_build_sees_its_target_dir_linked_to_the_slot_and_the_link_goes_after passes: the fake cargo reports 'link' and the readlink -f result equals the slot target, and symlink_metadata of the path errors after run. The slot target is build-slots/<n>/target beside the slots (lock) dir, the checks' warm dir, not literally inside slots_dir (see open_issues).

criteria_check.criterion: A test: two slotted runs one after the other in different job directories resolve to the same slot target directory, and a file written by the first run is still there in the second. Check: cargo test -p athena-cli slot_exec.
criteria_check.evidence: Test two_runs_in_different_jobs_share_the_slot_target_and_its_files passes; both reports resolve to slot 0's target and a.txt and b.txt are both present.

criteria_check.criterion: A test: unslotted subcommands (fmt, metadata) create no link, leave the slot directory untouched, and CARGO_TARGET_DIR is unchanged. Check: cargo test -p athena-cli slot_exec.
criteria_check.evidence: Test unslotted_subcommands_link_nothing_and_touch_no_slot_directory passes: cargo sees no link, the target path does not exist, and neither build-slots nor the slots dir gains anything.

criteria_check.criterion: D46 still holds: BuildLink::create is called with the job directory; a test shows a CARGO_TARGET_DIR outside the job directory is refused (warning, cargo runs unlinked) while an inside path is linked. Check: cargo test -p athena-cli and cargo test -p athena-agent.
criteria_check.evidence: Test a_target_dir_outside_the_job_is_refused_and_one_inside_is_linked passes. The job dir is the parent of shim.dir. The athena-agent tests are unchanged and were not rerun: env.rs is untouched.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo test (workspace) passes, cargo clippy --all-targets is clean, cargo fmt --check passes.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks; I ran cargo fmt --all and the targeted tests only.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md gains an entry stating only what the diff does: the producer's slotted cargo commands build in the slot's target directory via a temporary link; unslotted commands unchanged.

git diff shows changes only to crates/athena-cli/src/slot_exec.rs, CHANGELOG.md and possibly crates/athena-agent/src/env.rs; none to athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows or crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs.

open_issues: The criteria say <slots_dir>/<n>/target, but the shim's slots_dir holds the lock files. The link goes to <slots_dir's parent>/build-slots/<n>/target so the producer and the checks share the same warm directory. If the wrapper's slots_dir has no parent, or the shim dir has none, it builds unlinked.
Slot size-limit deletion is not done in the wrapper (out of scope).
mistakes: The first draft of the two-runs test overwrote the shared fake cargo script before the first run. Fixed by creating each job just before it runs.
learnings: CargoShim.slots_dir is state/slots (lock files). The warm target dirs are in state/build-slots/<n>/target (StateDir::slot_target), a sibling directory.
The wrapper reads the env only through the lookup closure, but the child inherits the process env, so tests bake paths into the fake cargo script.
